description: Essentures is inspired by the great games of the 90s and late 80s. You will experience a grand story driven adventure through 4 lore rich kingdoms wherein you can catch and collect mysterious creatures, using them as allies or weapons!

title: Starpoint Gemini 3
description:
"Get ready for an open-world space action single-player RPG. Enter the cockpit of wisecracking, hero Captain Jonathan Bold as he travels the vast universe of Starpoint Gemini 3.

Engage in action-packed space battles, visit amazing worlds and encounter interesting characters to find the answers you seek. For the first time in the franchise, Starpoint Gemini 3 brings animated 3D, NPCs that you can interact with, and this time your path leads beyond Gemini as you get to explore two new planetary systems.

You are not alone on your journey. You have ADAH, a digital consciousness that runs your ship's computer and can download itself onto your drone, which you can then control in ADAH’s role to accomplish off-ship tasks you could never do alone.

Buckle your seatbelts and prepare to immerse yourself in a world of space adventurer. Visit various venues, from pubs with shady clientele, to high-tech facilities and glitzy, noisy nightclubs, pick your targets and choose your allies. Your journey is about to begin."

title: Mechstermination Force
description:
"Join the Mechstermination Force and save the world from the gigantic MegaMechs!

Battle against massive bosses, jump and climb onto them to find their weakspots and blow them to kingdom come in this action packed platforming boss rush, from the creator of the Gunman Clive series.

When the MegaMechs have taken control of the world, one small group of brave soldiers are still fighting for humanity's independence.

Join them and lead the charge against the mechanical menace.
Get powerful weapons and upgrades! Use the Magnet Gloves to climb on top of robots the size of Skyscrapers, double jump over pools of lava with the Boost Boots, and use your trusty baseball bat to smash the MegaMechs energy cores.
‍
Take on the massive bosses alone or together with a friend in local co-op."

title: To Akimon
description: To Akimon is a game based upon one mechanic only. You will have to rely on your reflexes in order to progress. The game aims to maintain a minimalistic voxel-esque visual style while also accompanying you with a soundtrack inspired by 8-bit and synthwave music.

title: Path of Exile: Synthesis
description: In Path of Exile: Synthesis, players will meet Cavas and help him recover his lost memories by fighting their way through them and then stabilising them to collect a fragment of that memory.

title: Ring of Fire
description: Scour police records. Antagonize your suspects. Comb through a disturbing crime scene. You'll stop at nothing to expose the truth. Ring of Fire is a search-based detective noir puzzler with a mature narrative set in the hyper-stylized streets of New London.

title: Caterpillar Royale
description: It's the caterpillars' merciless growth competition! Defeat everyone else and be the last caterpillar standing!

title: The Last Player
description: The Last Player is a virtual reality battle royale game. The player will land on a battlefield with other competitors. Find weapons to arm yourself and use covers to hide from your enemies. There can be only one survivor! Enjoy the highly immersive and thrilling VR gaming experience!

title: Airborne Kingdom
description: Take a fantastical journey - fly the desert and build your domain. Airborne Kingdom uniquely blends city management and exploration, with a world and lore all its own. Build housing, gather food, satisfy needs, and grow your tribe. Maintain lift, discover resources, and explore the desert for lost technologies. The kingdom, your journey, their lives - all of it is up to you to decide.

title: Neverwinter: Undermountain
description: Undermountain is the 16th module of Neverwinter.

title: Guildmaster Story
description:
"In Guildmaster Story, you play the role of Guildmaster Ganyo, an up-and-coming entrepreneur with a timeless dream: To let a group of young, energetic adventurers build him a business empire that he doesn't have to pay for.

Through a combination of classic puzzle match gameplay, engaging characters and an original story, Guildmaster Story will delight everyone who ever worked an unpaid internship, got steamrolled by the sharing economy, or suspects that the people responsible for it all are precisely who they seem to be."

title: JetX Racing
description: JetX is an epic racing and arena game available on both PC and VR in 6DoF.

title: Monster Jam Steel Titans
description: Real Trucks. Real Action. Monster Jam! Monster Jam Steel Titans delivers the complete Monster Jam experience for everybody to enjoy!

title: Until You Fall
description: From the team behind I Expect You To Die comes this visually stunning VR sword fighting game. Melee and magic fuse to deliver a satisfying combat experience in which you are the master of your own martial style.

title: River City Melee Mach!!
description: Downtown Rantou Koushinkyoku Mach!! is an enhanced version of River City Melee: Battle Royal Special with new elements added that make for more heated battles.

title: Travis Strikes Again: No More Heroes - Black Dandelion
description:
This DLC includes the following:
- Shinobu Jacobs, a new playable character
- 2 unique Skills for Shinobu Jacobs
- New adventure mode starring Badman

title: The Voice Inside
description:
The Voice Inside is a psychological horror adventure game with different & challenging types of game control. Besides a modified controller & keyboard control system, the skill-based voice control type will give you a whole new voice-driven game experience.
You can choose between more than 30 commands to navigate a nearly blind character through a dark, infected and abstract world, while you solve puzzles, face enemies and perform actions to recover the light.
A voice inside the game will guide and help you to find a way out. Be Careful, 'the darkness' is watching your steps! Just listen, follow your intuition and give the right commands to reach your goal!

title: Mercenaries of Astonia
description: A massively multiplayer online role playing game. Each player begins their journey as a battle-hardened Templar, a magic-wielding Harakim, or a dabbler of both, a Mercenary. The experience gained as characters solve quests, discover new places, and kill evil monsters, can be applied to raise any of a large number of attributes, skills and spells. Characters gain rank and power, qualifying them for better and more powerful equipment for the new and greater challenges that lie ahead.

title: Clairvoyance
description: Clairvoyance is a martial arts roguelike where precision is everything. Developed by a martial artist specifically to capture the feel of real sparring, it offers character control far beyond what traditional fighting games allow, where you bob, weave, and strike in fast, lethal combat!

title: The Three Kingdoms of China
description: Three Kingdoms of China is a free, open-source single-machine strategy three-country game developed by the domestic folk team. The game does not have any commercial nature, hoping to create a dream of Three Kingdoms for the fans of the three kingdoms.

title: Tina: Swordswoman of the Scarlet Prison
description: Play as Tina and Cecile as they investigate Durham and try to uncover the cause of the village's sudden surge of crime. With the reappearance of an old foe, their job won't be easy.

title: Sail Forth
description: Heave! Fake the bull rope and stay the mizzen royal! Command a fleet of custom-rigged sailing ships on a procedurally crafted adventure over an unending ocean whose ancient depths have swallowed the key to a planet’s mysterious past. The Deepblue calls with the bellow of High Adventure! Sail Forth!

title: Furry Shakespeare: To Date or Not to Date Cat Girls?
description: It's Senior Year at Elsinore Academy. What's better than Senior Year? Well, Shakespeare characters that are the seniors, of course. What's even better than that? If they are Furries. It's Furry Shakespeare. You are welcome.

title: Puzzling Languages: German/English
description: A fun, simple way to pick up some new German vocabulary - 40 illustrated puzzles featuring both the English and German translation for a word.

title: Project Centauri
description: As you travel to find a new home for a near extinct species you reach Alpha Centauri. A safe haven from the zemulons a fierce warrior species but as you arrive to take this home as your own you the native population protect themselves from an invasion of there home world.

title: Balance Roll
description: "Balance Roll" is an exquisite indie game. Although the gameplay is simple, But actually you can't do that easily. Various traps and obstacles, all kinds of sports that ignore the laws of physics, four different theme styles, and even another horrible world...

title: Storage Kings
description: In Storage Kings, there's no place for hesitation or mercy. At the end of the day, the best ones count profits and the worst ones end with nothing. Which of these will you be?

title: Your Future Self
description: Your Future Self is a thrilling time loop "conversation-em-up" with a unique conversational "battle" mechanic. It harks back to the aesthetics of text-based adventure games whilst deliberately subverting your expectations; both in story and design.

title: Terraforming Earth
description: Control three clunky robots with improbable technological quirks stuck on a desolate Earth. Help them work together to overcome randomly generated obstacles in this roguelike puzzle platformer.

title: Astrox Imperium
description: Climb from your cryo-pod and enter the Void... Astrox Imperium is a space based rpg that offers familiar game play in an open-world universe. With tons of ships, upgrades, and options, being lost in space might just be fun.

title: Cyborg Invasion Shooter 3: Savior of the World
description: Cyborg Trilogy last part. Cyborg has got new human transform. Kill different enemies, run and try to find teleport to other levels and save the world.

title: Escape from Fortress Lugohm
description: Aisha was on her way home after having completed a mission for the guild. But on her way back, she was caught by the infamous Count Lugohm. Will she be able to escape from the clutches of Count Lugohm? Find out in this Stealth Survival RPG!

title: Miami Resort
description: Exciting Match 3 resort construction in Miami! Master linked boards, discover hidden obstacles and choose from various buildings which impact your gameplay experience.

title: Bullynoid
description: Bullynoid - This is a colorful breakout game in which you have to play for a bully! Beat the faces of passersby and onlookers! Take away their money! All of what sometimes you want to do in reality is now available in the game! Unlock new Freaky characters!

title: Line Loops: Logic Puzzles
description: Line Loops - Logic Puzzles is a relaxing and challenging logic game, where you try to form a single continuous loop to solve a puzzle. Use the numbers as clues to loop through thousands of unique logic puzzles. Can you solve them all?

title: Escape Route
description: Escape Route is an intense and engaging stealth game. Your focus here is to try and reach the destination while trying to avoid detection. It’s not easy to do that, and you must do everything you can in order to maintain your stealth and engage your enemies in combat. There are different weapons you need to deal with, like machine guns, press machines, noise detectors, lasers and so on. You need to use all your skills to figure out exactly how to master every level. You get 25 levels to go through, each one with its own range of unique challenges. Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate stealth attacker?

title: Sticks and Bones
description: Follow the story of a brave, courageous and handsome pirate as he continues his journey to find THE treasure after his death!

title: BluBoy: The Journey Begins
description: A Teen age boy going in search of his missing grandfather. On the way of his journey he discovers more secrets and surprises.

title: Its Fun to Break Things
description: It's Fun To Break Things is the best way to escape as you smash everything in your vicinity to pieces. Be a "bull in a china shop" and aim for the high score as you progress through the levels. Offered up in virtual reality this will really get you moving.

title: Our Children - Escaping Earth
description: You are J.E.S. An AI put to protect what's left of earth. Defend bunkers, gather resources, and unlock new technologies to preserve our children and escape to mars.

title: Pax Romana
description: Pax Romana: Romulus is an RPG/Adventure game that takes the mythological story of Romulus and Remus, legendary founders of Rome, on a different fiction. In the meantime, let the players create their own farm and design home.

title: Hyperfight
description: Hyperfight is a fighting game where every hit is lethal, and every win counts. Featuring new characters and modes for maximized battle!

title: Pumpkin Days
description: Pumpkin Days is a farming dating rpg. Have fun with activities like farming, fishing, cooking, raising animals, mining, crafting, house customization, dating townsfolk and more all in a large 3D environment with a cute anime-inspired aesthetic.

title: My Beautiful Paper Smile
description: My Beautiful Paper Smile is a story about a child trapped in a facility that raises children to be perfect. Their upmost joy is required at all times. They must smile always, never frowning; always happy, never saddened.

title: DooM in the Dark
description: The space station has undergone an unknown contamination from space, the previously unknown X virus mutates, almost the entire station crew is infected, you need to stop the army of mutants before they break through to Earth and doomsday began!

title: 5.84 Wing
description: 5.84 Wing - Minimalist action-adventure game, with many levels for which you have to overcome a lot of obstacles to collect keys and open doors.

title: Norman's Night In
description: Norman finds himself lost in a cave with nothing but his new bowling ball and a weird feeling that somehow he was meant to be there.

title: Trikumax
description: Trikumax is a free-running boss rush game following Gaea, the protector of the mysterious: "Fauna Island"! Help her defeat the sinister Captain Dr. Surriv, along with his mechanized army, and free the island from his grasp!

title: Trap Shrine
description: The Trap was a Goddess?! The enshrined deity turned out to be a cross dressing Goddess that was sealed to... marry me?! This new frontier in the world of cutie boy visual novels is brought to you by the ultimate team! The cross dressing legend starts here!

title: Bud Blitz
description: Bud Blitz is a fast-paced cannabis-themed action/arcade game with a splash of simulation. Grow as much cannabis as you can while defending your crops from enemies by using a variety of outrageous weapons!

title: Axyos: Battlecards
description: Meet Axyos: Battlecards, the brand new tactical card game! Experience yourself in a role of the commander. Play multiplayer with your friends. Invent and utilize different tactics in a battle!

title: Sacred Grove Solitaire
description: In a magical land far away, there is a beautiful island inhabited by elves. A sacred grove has granted these elves powerful magic but one day everything changed. A powerful earthquake has destroyed the island along with the sacred grove. The Elven Queen seeks your help to restore the island.

title: Luxor Solitaire
description: The Gods have summoned you to the banks of the Nile. Solve Solitaire-Levels and use your skills to build the great city of Luxor.

title: Winter Solitaire
description: In this magical Solitaire game you must defeat the Ice Queen before the land is sealed in eternal winter!

title: PuppetShow: Porcelain Smile - Collector's Edition
description: Can you stop a madman from using puppets to take over the island?

title: The Far Kingdoms: Awakening Solitaire
description: In this addictive solitaire game the Princess of the Kingdom, your sister has fallen in a deep sleep for days and no one has been able to wake her! It's now clear that this is the work of an evil spell. Find the Elixir of Awakening to save her. The journey will be long and dangerous, but it's your sister's only hope.

title: cockroach Planet Survival
description: cockroach planet Survival is a Single-player, survival game. Players need to find food and find out how to escape while protecting themselves against enemies and escape.

title: The Psychiatrist: Major Depression
description: In this kafkaesque interactive fiction you will be a psychiatrist and will try to treat a patient diagnosed with major depression. Unique Mix: Simulation, RPG and Interactive Fiction at the same time.

title: TetraLogical
description: A turn-based slotting in / strategy game with a BIG twist!... Play either Solo, or against up to 3 CPU *or* Human players. Take turns to place your pieces onto the board, trying to score the maximum points you can with your current piece.

title: Planet of Pirates
description: Planet of Pirates is a cross-platform game, which allows players to battle each other by controlling their ship in various arenas and game modes.

title: Shawy Adventures
description: Shawy Adventures is a Retro Action Platformer inspired on the early Game Boy games.

title: Ultimate Coaster X
description: Ultimate Coaster X is a free roller coaster simulator built with simplicity and utility in mind. The in-game roller coaster and world editors allow you to create and experience rides of many types.

title: Lost King's Lullaby
description: Lost King's Lullaby is a roguelike game with RPG elements. We will venture forth with Kiara in a Celtic adventure, exploring different maze-like procedurally generated worlds. We will face enemies in frenetic battles where we will have to make use of our reflexes and choose between different abilities to beat the menacing creatures.

title: The Castles of Burgundy
description: Stefan Feld's highly decorated board game "The Castles Of Burgundy" by Ravensburger is getting its digital version on Steam! Enjoy against the challenging AI or friends a beautiful digital version of the classic board game!

title: Pathfinder: Kingmaker - Varnhold's Lot
description:
You join Varn - as his general - and experience Varnhold's valorous history first-hand; the whole of it, not just the outcome!

Just as you were claiming your first title, another hero of the Stolen Lands became a baron too: Maegar Varn, captain of the Varnling Host mercenary band and rightful ruler of Varnhold

If you've played the main campaign, you already know what happened to him... or do you?

title: Outlaws of the Old West
description: Outlaws of the Old West is a massively multiplayer survival MMO with a huge world, thousands of items and a modular building system. Survive the wild, build your own homestead, defeat villainous bandits and work with others to tame the Wild West.

title: Infinite Chili Sauce
description: Casual and relaxed placement game, hang your time in your leisure time and build your own chili sauce empire.

title: The Morrigan
description: Raid the direful catacombs of the Morrigan, the Celtic Queen of the dead, if you dare. Built exclusively for VR.

title: Baby Redemption
description: Baby Redemption is a high paced rogue-like shooter where you have to save babies in glorious intense slow-motion action. Weapons, bullets, babies, fun and bullet-time. What more do you need?

title: Going Medieval
description: Build and manage your own castle settlement in a land reclaimed by wilderness. With detailed management, survival strategy, and a moddable sandbox world, Going Medieval challenges you to build the mightiest colony this side of the apocalypse.

title: Voipas
description: Voipas is a virtual assistant for PC, aiming to be a virtual friend. In case you need a companion while browsing your PC, someone to give you an advice when you feel down, to cheer you, give you a virtual kiss or remind you to study for exams.

title: Fantasy Smith VR
description: FantasySmithVR is a stimulation-type VR game. Players can experience how to make a weapon, and how to interact with characters or creatures in the shop. The fantasy world setting makes the forging more interesting, magic potion and floating crystals virtually engage players in an incredible magic world.

title: Book End
description: Book End is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. It stars Shiori, the main goal being to explore the dream world and collect Spells.

title: Deep Space Waifu: World
description: Oh no! Bear King was sent to the worst place in the Universe… Earth! Assemble the Bear Rescue Team! It's time for a world tour of cloth damage in giant girls - global warming, you've got nothing on us!

title: Save Thine Kingdom
description: A light-hearted journey of a King trying to save his Kingdom from the malevolent Doombringer.

title: Gungrave VR U.N
description: Become the legendary undead gunman Beyond the Grave in this standalone sequel to Gungrave VR featuring new levels, enemies, and play styles. Master Grave's punishing arsenal of attacks and abilities to mow down waves of mutant bad guys.

title: Road Rage Royale
description: Road Rage Royale is a racing fighting game for two to four players. Be the "last man racing" in a cyberpunk post-apocalyptic demolition derby.

title: NeverMore
description:
A rogue-lite experience based in a gothic/fantasy realm. You play as one of the Ascended Adventurers that have come to save Blackwall from the forces of evil who have overrun a nearby cathedral. You will adventure through the Everwood Forest: a procedural forest composed of various events and monsters. Gather whatever strength and power you may find, for the cathedral has lost all its light.

IF you survive that, your new-found power will allow you the opportunity to raid the infamous Light's Wake Cathedral on your quest to descend into the depths and slay any who stand in your path. Will you be able to drive out the forces of darkness and cleanse this once holy site?

IF Nevermore finally takes you, he may yet favour your reverence and grant you a permanent glimmer of your former power, advancing your Ascended and making them more powerful for each run.

title: Uniland
description: It is a multi-play strategy game made by the combination of turn-based and roguelike. Master clever tactics, awaken strong talent, recruit powerful troops, create grand city-states, and so on, quickly enter the Uniland, lead your troops to unravel the ultimate mystery of this chaotic continent.

title: Oi, Innkeep! - Chronicles!
description: Step into a world of food and magic! Throw vampire parties, commit insurance fraud, meet talking mops, save magic mirrors, snort Fairy Dust and more in this narrative-driven, adventure prequel series to Oi, Innkeep!

title: Cannon Fire: Bloody Sea
description: Yo-ho-ho, and a bottle of rum! It's not an easy task, being a captain of a ship, and to constantly defend it against enemy ships is even harder. Run your crew, complete missions and defeat the Pirate Leader!

title: Ultra-Gene Code
description: Ultra-Gene Code is a sci-fi visual novel with horror elements that constantly confronts you with a difficult moral choice.

title: Our Secret Below
description:
Our Secret Below is an escape room puzzle game.

Play as Nia Davis to solve various puzzles, find clues, and help her escape to freedom. However, there is more to this story to this encounter than the surface implies.

Dig deep, be resourceful, and learn what your captor’s intentions really are.

title: Cold Calling
description: Operate a telephone switchboard, meet caricatured historical figures, and avert a nuclear war in this alternate history Cold War comedy. Use tactile point-and-click controls to drag wires and install wacky gadgets as you juggle waves of calls.

title: Cube Human
description: Cube Human is a cooperative adventure game，the city is the main stage of the cube Human.

title: Robot Female Hero 1
description: What if you combined the weird logic and stories of anime and every single RPG ever, and smartass American internet humor and reasoning? Well you get this old sport!

title: Wallace & Gromit's Grand Adventures: Episode 1 - Fright of the Bumblebees
description: Wallace has invented a fast and easy way to get honey from bees and started with the help of his dog Gromit a honey-business. Sadly customers are none-existent and the bills keep piling up until one day Mr. Paneer shows up and orders 50 gallons of honey - by evening. Wallace agrees to the deal but quickly finds out that he hasn't nearly enough flowers to produce that much honey in just a few hours.

title: Night is Coming
description: Night is Coming is a survival building simulation set within the unforgiving cold of the Carpathian mountains. Build your settlement, nurture and protect your people - prepare for impending Darkness. Will everyone survive? Will evil displace your homestead? Will a Hero emerge?

title: Pursuer
description: You are a pursuer, and your job is to catch a criminal who has more than 20 victims.

title: Successor of the Moon
description: A classic 2D side-scrolling action (Metroidvania) game. The young priestess embarks on a journey to solve the monsters' suspicious movements in Parthenope. Seek the help of your peers and elves, Acquire a variety of abilities, and reach the end to discover the truth.

title: Adventures Diary of Merchant
description: "Adventures Diary of Merchant" is an educational simulation game where allows you to build farms and pasture factories, process products by raw materials, sell and purchase materials at the market, rent houses, and build shops to sell goods.

title: The Princess, the Stray Cat, and Matters of the Heart
description: Once upon a time, after his mother passed away, a boy called Nora felt all alone in the world. He spent every day with his unique and kind hearted friends until one fateful day, he had a chance encounter with a princess from the Netherworld.

title: Jìgěi Míngrì de Xīwàng
description: This is a visual novel telling a love story set on a school campus. The story consists of a common route and two individual routes, collectively constructing a backdrop where the school and society intersect. It follows the protagonist as they search for love and overcome their confusion.

title: Extreme Racing on Highway
description: Race through highway traffic in this new endless racing game where you need to push the acceleration and test your car limits and receive money for your rewards and spend them on upgrades & new cars!

title: Gachimuchi: The Card Game
description: Hey buddy, I think you've got the wrong door, the leather club's two blocks down.

title: The Secret Order 7: Shadow Breach
description: There are dark secrets that have an annoying tendency to crawl back into the light, escaping oblivion. But there is also Sarah Pennington, the most skilled agent of the ever-watching Secret Order, who is there to face them.

title: Cyborg Ninja vs. The Third Reich
description: Cyborg Ninja vs. The Third Reich is a 2D action platforming game! Become a Cyborg Ninja and destroy the Nazi menace in this throwback to the 16 bit side scrolling glory days!

title: Gladiator: Blades of Fury
description: Gladiator: Blades of Fury is a melee combat action fighting game set during the medieval period. Players can play as a gladiator from four different clans, namely the Barbarians, the Assassins, the Knights, and the Dwarves. All heroes are unique and have their own weapons, skills, and fighting styles.

title: Nano Driller
description: A brisk, soothing action-puzzle game. At a playtime of 25-45 minutes, this game offers a condensed, yet polished and complete experience, and can be enjoyed fresh or replayed at any time of the day.

title: Lamentum
description:
Lamentum is a pixel art survival-horror game set in New England in the mid-nineteenth century. To solve the dark secret at the heart of Grau Hill Mansion, you will have to immerse yourself in a nightmare world full of terrible creatures.

Choose well in whom to trust, every decision you make may alter the course of the story.

Will you survive?

title: Jumping Master
description: Jumping Master is a innovative casual competitive game fully merged with classic gameplay of mushroom game. It aims to help us revisit the classic mushroom game in our chlidhood. Based on the unique designed mushroom map and real-time multiplayer cooperation, players need to jump to elud the cliff and other players' attack, collect...

title: It's Winter
description: Panel houses, snow, overcast sky, tiny kitchen, shabby staircase… It's Winter is an indie game which genre could be classified as sandbox, post-soviet, sad 3d, russian sadness. Nothing awaits you: there is no chance to get out, no room for adventures and breathtaking plot.

title: Apostle
description: 50 years have passed since the monsters last threatened humanity. In those years, life has returned to normal. However, this peace can't last forever. Play as Rei Yagami as his life is changed forever.

title: Next Stop 3
description: Margaret needs your help once again! You must repair the railway over 50 levels, build a sorting center and win in a billion-dollar escapade!

title: Game Studio Simulator
description: Make a Game Company for your self！Get it work，Run for Rich！

title: Light of Gallery
description: Light Of Gallery is brand New Maze Running Game! Escape From the Secret Art Hall!

title: And I Must Scream
description: And I Must Scream is an experience horror game that takes the player through a journey of kid's imagination of how he perceives the world around him. Control Max as he navigates the literal and metaphorical landscapes of trauma on his search for strength and acceptance.

title: Mortadelo y Filemón: La Banda de Corvino
description: Mort & Phil, created by Ibáñez, return to the charge in the world of the video game of the hand of spanish Alcachofa Soft. Three games in one is offers "La Banda del Corvino".

title: Beyond Enemy Lines: Operation Arctic Hawk
description: Think your way in, observe the enemies and sneak into their base. Rescue an as hostage held agent from an unknown arms dealer, adapt to changing weather conditions, and use the the darkness of the night to your favor in this unforgiving, intense experience where skill and tactical decisions matter!

title: Rogue Star Rescue
description: Bullet Hell Insanity + Tower Defense Strategy. Rogue Star Rescue is a quirky new type of rogue-like shooter. Blast your way through diverse planets while rescuing your teammates and gathering traps for your defense strategy.

title: La Fuga
description: Seven days to escape from prison, in this Spanish cult graphic adventure.

title: Quantum Legend - vr show
description: A sneak action game,This software only provides visual and survival mode experience.

title: Walk the Fort
description: Reclaim your homeland with the ultimate guardian - a living, walking fort with an entire arsenal strapped to its back! This shoot 'em up arcade with tower defense elements lets you take the battle to your enemies!

title: The Abbey: Director's cut
description: The Abbey: Director’s Cut offers a significantly refined version of the original Murder in the Abbey, enhancing both the presentation and gameplay while adding new content and quality-of-life features. It maintains the core mystery and historical atmosphere of the original while making it more accessible and enjoyable for modern players.

title: Mortadelo y Filemón: Una aventura de cine - Edición especial
description: The return of the adventures "Two sloppy cowboys" and "Terror, horror and fear" in a special edition that is the best and most modern work of the Spanish studio Alcachofa Soft in the franchise.

title: SuperBeam
description: Super Beam is a fascinating VR rhythm game which has variety of methods to be with fantastic music. When targets are coming to you, you can slash them out and you will feel fantastic VR experence. You can feel like dancing while slashing targets listening to music!!

title: Tales of Nebezem RPG: Red Peril
description: Magical RPG in a rich colorful world, with tactical battles and an immersive story

title: Furry Chronicles
description: Furry Chronicles is a classic sidescrolling platformer game with challenging levels and puzzles.

title: Owling. Crowling. Bowling!
description: Take part in an incredible magic school bowling tournament! Immerse yourself in an amazing adventure, destroy the plans of the Crowly faculty with your loyal feathered defenders. Use your skills to beat your opponents and lead your faculty to victory!

title: Chocolate makes you happy: Lunar New Year
description: Casual colorful physical puzzle with sweets, jumpers, teleports, accelerators, reverse gravity, traps, treadmills, fires, paper lanterns, dragons and explosions.

title: Junglex
description: Rex got lost in this hostile jungle! Help him finish the levels and leave this place!

title: A way up!
description: A way up! is a simple platformer about throwing a rock. WARNING - you may find it really hard.

title: Space Smash
description: Inspired by classic Arcade games, Space Smash is a fast, addictive and retro shoot 'em up!

title: Mage VR: The Lost Memories
description: Maybe you don't remember, but some of us do remember that we are Mages. Try a gesture, see if it starts fire in your hands, maybe you are one of us. Use this power and please save the world from this new malediction.

title: Disobedient Sheep
description: Disobedient Sheep is a frantic and lighthearted sheep herding party game for two to four players. Play as sheepdogs and guide your flock to victory in four different game-modes by avoiding anvils, dodging dynamite, and bailing on boulders.

title: Struggling
description: A physics-based coop game where each player controls one of the arms of a hideous thing. You will go on a journey full of absurd encounters to find the abomination gods and receive their blessings. At long last a game that lets you incarnate a screeching pile of flesh!

title: Reflections: Dreams and Reality
description: A visual novel about a girl who wishes to escape her fate and those who follow closely behind her.

title: Wénzìyù
description: The protagonist is trapped inside a prison, please help the protagonist to escape this place by making sentences and unravel the secrets of this prison.

title: Mistress of Maids: First Castle
description: Turn-based, but fast-paced, roguelike-game when you do not need to think over each turn and count the HP. Mistress of Maids: First Castle is a playable alpha of the game we are currently working on.

title: Super Space Jump Man
description: Super Space Jump Man is a fun and challenging gravity based runner. Traverse from planet to planet while dodging spikes, lasers and collecting oxygen.

title: Grater
description: A 2D platformer full of riddles, collecting, shooting and frozen time.

title: Minskies
description: Minskies Furballs is not a port, but a spiritual clone of Puyo Puyo. In a tournament against a cast of crazy characters, you must guide and rotating falling pairs of cats of different colours to make up colour combinations.

title: Shift Shaft
description: Take Shaft on his way to find his meaning of existence! Shift Shaft is an Indie Side-Scroller with a variety of gamemodes to play.

title: Real Fishing VR
description: Real Fishing VR is a fishing game that travels around the world. You can easily catch over 100 kinds of fish with simple, rhythmic actions.

title: Malevolence
description: Malevolence is a 9 map single player Boom Compatible episode tested in PrBoom+. It features extensive dehacked changes to enemies and weapons. It pits you against an evil SuperAI and its cyborg army as you try to shut down Malevolence before Earth gets converted into cyborg central.

title: Haprokon
description: In Haprokon You will try to satisfy Your increasingly spoiled Population by producing lots of different Goods - From Apples to Zinc.

title: Lovers ' Smiles 2
description: Casual puzzle where you need to help two lovers to meet each other. Use your fantasy and the physical laws, draw incredible designs to connect Mr. and Miss Smile!

title: The Path to Die
description: Travel to Feudal Japan and use your right stick as your katana to slay your enemies in this action and adventure game represented in pixel art and top down view.

title: Land War
description: Local 8 player strategy! Expand your territory and be the last square standing! Simple controls for casual friends and deep strategy for gamers.

title: fullybroKen#4
description:
fullybroKen#4 puts you in the shoes of a genetically engineered human in a country ravaged by a constant war between three factions.

Combat in a match-3 fashion, help the war efforts of the one of the three factions, choose the destiny of Mir, choose your own destiny and learn unique spells in which each of them has unique properties

title: HexaCycle
description: Procedurally generated logic puzzle game

title: Darksiders III: The Crucible
description:
In this mighty morsel of digital wonderment, competitors can expect to receive a truly earth-shattering experience: The Crucible!

A legendary challenge whispered with reverence across the universe. Not even the Creator could have envisioned such glorious spectacle as that which is found in this fabled arena.

title: Goblin Quest: Escape!
description: Goblin Quest: Escape! is an award-winning action-packed dungeon crawler, action-rpg and reverse tower defense hybrid from BotBite Industries.

title: Alt-Frequencies
description: Alt-Frequencies takes players on an audio-based journey where interactive investigation meets podcasting, and players are tasked with unravelling a mystery taking place between multiple radio stations among a disparate group of people.

title: Late Night 1320
description: Experience a blast to the past of old school drag racing in its purest form. Find a variety of classic cars, trucks, and odd vehicles from the junkyard and rescue them from their inevitable demise. Once you've restored and fixed your junker, take it to the backroads and compete against a variety of racers to earn their respect. Work your way up the chain and gain rep with the local crowd. Discover new drag spots to further work your way up the chain and continue upgrading your car. Compete at the drag strip for the ultimate test against sponsored racers and become the Late Night king.

title: Metamorphosis
description: An interactive visual novel in the mystical genre. Mikey is admitted to an unusual institution for treatment, where he encounters supernatural phenomena and begins to prepare for a metamorphosis that will lead him into another world.

title: Warsaw Rising: City of Heroes
description: A beautifully presented tale of unforgiving combat in a war torn city. Warsaw is a WWII turn-based tactical rpg with beautiful hand painted graphics. Lead a small, dedicated outfit of civilians and soldiers with their unique skills in their fight to take back the city besieged by occupying forces.

title: Tower Princess
description:
TowerPrincess is a 3D action-platformer that recovers the spirit of the classical adventure games, as Zelda, Crash Bandicoot, Ratchet & Clank or Mario, and merges it with roguelike mechanics!

This means that the dungeon, the rewards, the challenges or even the character will be procedural, making every gameplay unique!

It's a parody of the classical "knight who enters into the dragon's castle and rescues the princess". Only that this time one does not just "rescue the princess".

The knight will have to date her while goes through the dungeon, before the evil Dragon notices him and burns everything down!

title: Wooden Nickel
description:
Wooden Nickel is a narrative adventure set in a frontier town of the great, remorseless Old West.

This is the third game from married duo Brain&Brain, best known for folktale adventure Burly Men at Sea. The game began pre-production in 2017 and is currently in development, with no release date announced as yet.

title: Iragon
description: Iragon is both a VR and non-VR story-driven action game, set in a fantasy medieval world filled with magic, elves, and wizards. The non-VR mode allows the player to experience it from a 3rd person’s perspective.

title: ACA Neo Geo: The Ultimate 11 - SNK Football Championship
description: The Ultimate 11 - SNK Football Championship is a soccer game released by SNK in 1996. Choose your favorite of 80 different teams, more than ever before, and conquer the two Championship modes! Choose from 4 styles of team balance to customize your team according to your own playing style!

title: Unity of Command II
description: Unity of Command II is the sequel to one of the most critically acclaimed strategy games of all time; a game critics called 'the perfect gateway' into computer war games.

title: Pirates of First Star
description: Pirates of First Star is a puzzle adventure game where you'll have to explore and battle to solve the great mystery of the First Star treasure.

title: Virtual Battlegrounds
description: Virtual Battlegrounds is the ultimate Battle Royale being built from the ground up for virtual reality. Battle to become the last man standing on this apocalyptic war-crazed island through tactical gun-play, an epic map, and physical based controls for skydiving, climbing, shooting, ziplining, and driving.

title: Dissidia Final Fantasy NT: Free Edition
description:
Dissidia Final Fantasy NT: Free Edition is packed with iconic stages and music from the entire Final Fantasy series, a cast of over 25 beloved characters with unique fighting styles and abilities, legendary summons that wreak destruction on the arena and much more.

Available for play in both online and offline gameplay modes, players of both Dissidia Final Fantasy NT: Free Edition and the full Dissidia Final Fantasy NT game can challenge each other in exhilarating fights with a weekly rotation of four unique characters from the huge roster available.

title: Warhammer: Vermintide 2 - Winds of Magic
description: The first expansion for Warhammer: Vermintide 2 brings a brand new enemy faction and new challenges to the game. As a meteor crashes down in the Reikland, the Beastmen emerge from the depths of the Reikwald forest and rush to the epicenter to claim it as a Herdstone. It is up to the 5 heroes to stop them before a dreadful disaster strikes the Empire.

title: Battlestar Galactica Deadlock: Sin and Sacrifice
description:
Lucinda Cain, the Agathon sisters and all the other protagonists of Battlestar Galactica Deadlock will need to face their greatest threat yet: Lachesis, the powerful IL-series commander, has awakened and nothing will be the same.

Battlestar Galactica Deadlock is back with a new expansion! In Sin and Sacrifice, the epic story of Deadlock continues, and brings with it an exciting conclusion to the Season One storyline.

title: World of Tanks: Roll Out Collector's Edition
description:
The World of Tanks Roll Out Collector's Edition Box includes:

- A Replica of the Tiger 131 in action.
- Blueprints
- Artbook
- Gaming Mouse
- Keychain
- Lithographs
- DLC
Tiger 131
3 Garage Slots
Crew 100%
10 Large repair kit
10 Large First aid kit
10 Automatic Fire Extinguisher
10 Chocolate
30 Premium Days
1,000,000 Credits
- Certificate (Numbered 1-5130)
- Premium Packaging

title: Interpoint
description: Interpoint is a first-person sci-fi mystery with elements of psychological horror. A secret organization made the discovery of parallel worlds. You are Harry G., a scientist, who took part in a project that was supposed to benefit all of humanity.

title: Pirate Cannons Ahoy!
description: Ahoy mateys! Take charge of your fort defenses as hostile pirates invade to steal your treasure! Defend your treasure chests in this classic cannon-shooting take in this casual tower-defense game.

title: Globat Pixels
description: Are you tired of playing on the same old maps over and over again? Well fear no more! With globat pixels you can choose wherever in the world that you want to play. And you dont even have to play alone! You can either fight with your friends or with bots. So stop your boredom and play anywhere you want!

title: Minimal Move
description: A cooperative puzzle game in 3D! Your adventure starts when two space investigators, Kaiten and Ido landed in a wonder cubic world for discovering the truth of the planet… Are you a fan of a challenging and intellectual puzzle game? Engage your brain, cooperate with each other, and think in 3D!

title: Froggo
description: Nice minimal casual game about Froggy & Co.

title: Spellsword Cards: Demontide
description: A unique solo quest card combat adventure with 500+ cards, drafting, roguelike and puzzle modes of play. The campaign features a unique MULTI-CLASSING SYSTEM and 50 boss fights plus hundreds of encounters.

title: Edge of Galaxy
description: Edge of Galaxy is a real-time tactical space sim with RPG elements. You are the commander of a small fleet of mercenaries. Manage your fleet! Hire and dismiss, adjust and improve every ship, and increase your rank and glory!

title: Lyratha: Labyrinth - Survival Escape
description: Far away from the fate of the world and time, deep in catacombs and vaults of long-forgotten places, the Lyratha Order conceals his existence, without knowledge of humanity outside.

title: Mostly Scared of Spiders
description: Exploring in the Australian outback, you become separated from your party. Can you survive and safely make your way out? "Mostly Scared of Spiders" is an exciting journey into the Australian outback.

title: Drunkard Quiz Show Hyoutan
description: It is a game of quiz program format. You choose one of four challengers to capture four genres. Each genre has a partner who comes out with a quiz, and if defeated by that partner, the challenger will be made into alcohol.

title: Full Pitch
description: Avoid disaster. Pass check points. Believe in yourself.

title: Let's Worm
description: Let's Worm is in a league of its own. You can even lose during the tutorial! It's casual but hardcore. A cutscene-based story where the controls are simple, but the gameplay complex.

title: Trap for Winners
description: A gripping sci-fi interactive thriller that lets you shape your own character and his morality. You make the choices – and suffer the consequences!

title: Out of the Park Baseball 20
description: Officially licensed by MLB, MiLB and the MLBPA, OOTP 20 is a baseball fan's dream come true and the only game ever to win the Metacritic PC Game of the Year Award twice. Step into the shoes of a GM and/or manager to own the future or rewrite the past of your favorite real-world baseball franchise. Build the team the way you want. Start a new career with your favorite 2019 MLB team or go back through almost 150 years of baseball history and run any team from the past! You can even set up your own fictional baseball universe.

title: Mad Gun Range VR Simulator
description: Welcome to Mad Gun Range VR Simulator! Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of this modern world! Now you do not need to go to the landfill to shoot. Thanks to the incredibly realistic graphics, you are guaranteed a complete immersion!

title: Hockey: Strategy of Success
description: You like hockey, don’t you? Then experience how does it feel to be a hockey team manager.

title: Boom! Boom!
description: "Boom! Boom!" is a fireworks rhythm game. Let's blow rockets!

title: Figure Quest
description: You're a figure. Lots of obstacles stand in your way and you need to escape. Don't get hit and maybe you'll escape.

title: Extricate
description: Extricate is a fast-paced 3D platformer, where your goal is to get through the 50 levels while avoiding obstacles using a variety of mechanics.

title: Groomer
description: Groomer is a relaxing simulation game where take on a role of groomer, a person that takes care of dogs.

title: Once Upon a Death
description: Play as a sinister sorcerer who discovered the secret knowledge of necromancy. Raise an undead army, start a zombie apocalypse and seize the throne!

title: Shoot the Zombirds VR
description: Shoot The Zombirds VR is a gallery shooter starring undead birds, pumpkins and a crossbow. Excellent shooting fun for all skill levels with support for home-made accessories for extra immersion.

title: FanaticBlader
description: An easy and fast 3D Side-Scroll action game, "Fanatic Blader" Challenge the "Cursed Tower" that any wish will come true!

title: vApe Escape
description: vApe Escape is a point-and-click adventure in a science fiction comedy setting. The player takes control of an innocent ape who must escape the sad destiny of becoming a vape dispenser machine for the wealthy hipsters of the universe.

title: The Burned Ground
description: THE BURNED GROUND is a MMO-action game in which the last surviving participant wins.Explore the island, play with friends, but remember only the strongest will survive! This is the BATTLE ROYALE!

title: Greed 3: Old Enemies Returning
description: "Greed 3: Old Enemies Returning" is the last part of the thrilling "Greed" triology! Dr. Goodwin's miracle cure is once again under threat and Sara has contacted you for help. Old enemies are up to new tricks at Pontoon Laboratories and this time they are willing to kill to get their hands on the cure.

title: Bioszard Corporation
description: In a near future, Bioszard Dev grew powerful and wealthy. The once small game development studio turned into a global scale corporation seeking to dominate, buying corrupted politicians and crazy scientists to transform humans into beasts, zombies and other unspeakable things.

title: Amanda's Sticker Book 2: Amazing Wldlife
description: After winning her first sticker book competition, Amanda has her eyes set on even greater heights. Help Amanda create award-winning sticker books. Swap stickers, earn power-ups and clear each puzzle to make Amanda's new dream come true.

title: Escape from the Tomb Tower
description: Escape from the crypt tower, where spent hundreds of years. Dark atmosphere and riddles.

title: B.M.G 19: Bike Messenger Go!
description: Get in the role of an urban bike messenger, ride, walk and sometimes use a car trough the city and deliver letters just in time. Race and chase in the streets or in the velodrome! Earn money with deliveries or in competitions and spend it for your individual style and ingame features!

title: Spellcasting Collection
description: Steve Meretzky's trilogy of magic-themed collegiate text adventures-with-graphics for Legend. The sometimes-smutty but never-beyond-softcore stories put the player in the shoes of one Ernie Eaglebeak, a wizard-in-training at at Sorcerer University.

title: Waves of the Atlantide
description: A finite world with infinite resources. Defeat your opponents before the world collapses under your empire in this epic Battle Royale RTS! A tidal wave is putting an end to this continent, will you make it through?

title: Poggers
description: Take control of Bun-Bun Poggers the adorable bunny rabbit in this classic retro arcade game where the goal is to cross a dangerous field of cobras and a then cross a wide river by jumping on floating logs to get him home!

title: Curious Expedition 2
description: Curious Expedition 2 is a turn-based narrative roguelike set in a reimagined version of the late 19th century that uses procedural gameplay and story elements to create completely unique and epic adventures every time you play.

title: Fallout 76: Wild Appalachia
description: A mythical beast, a lost generation of scouts, and the strongest brew this side of the wasteland. Welcome to Wild Appalachia – a series of free and all-new quests, features, events, crafting systems and more starting today in Fallout 76.

title: Aero Attack: Retro Space Shooter
description: Aero Attack is a retro shooter arcade game where you play as a pilot named Bob, tasked to defend the human race from various aerial minions. Fly his shooting plane through space, dodge the floating minions, alien bosses, satellites, and a couple of space cows. The game aimed to make people feel nostalgic and sentimental, remembering the retro games everyone loved spending time on and the emotions they stirred in us.

title: The Sorrowvirus: A Faceless Short Story
description: Faceless: The Sorrowvirus contains an original OST by David Denyer, with accompanying sound design by John Pata. Each instance of gameplay will result in different dialogues to help you find the true ending, as well as discover more of the story behind Faceless. Elements have been extracted from the main game, giving you an idea as to the scenery of the partially derelict Wakeland City that will be seen in Faceless.

title: Initen
description: INITEN is a third-person exploration experience in which sound plays an important part!

title: Vind
description: Vind is a game about helping people, getting to know both characters and the world they reside in, and having an amazing adventurous journey doing so.

title: Bishoujo Mangekyou: Norowareshi Densetsu no Shoujo
description:
Onogami Shigehiko, a teacher at an all-girls school, is a man of love - of love towards beautiful young girls - and to this day he has managed to keep this hidden from those around by playing as Mr. Serious.

From the fear of losing his beloved career as a teacher, he has had to abstain from crossing the line with any of his students until now.

...Indeed, until now, until he met Kagarino Kirie, a mysterious girl of stunning beauty - it is this meeting that finally derails him into crossing that line, a line that was better left not crossed.

title: Bishoujo Mangekyou: Wasurenagusa to Eien no Shoujo
description:
The protagonist, Kanzaki Akihito, was once a cheerful boy.

Only having grown up, he was now with heart problems; friends of old were friends no more; and more often than not, he was not seen attending school.

His mind was darkened mostly by his childhood friend and first love Sawatari Shizuku, and the fact that she had been unreachable for a while now.

He felt as if she had betrayed him.

Gray days pass by, and once more Shizuku appears before Akihito...

Again the story starts moving, and to a direction not one of them had expected...

title: Bishoujo Mangekyou: Katsute Shoujo Datta Kimi he
description:
In the middle of the mountains stands an isolated, rural hot springs inn.

There works the beautiful waitress, Haru Inamori.

Souta Kamijou, the lover of Haru, secretly pays a visit to the inn in order to surprise her...

When the idiot couple of adults interlock, a steaming hot night of love ensues...

title: Bishoujo Mangekyou: Kami ga Tsukuritamouta Shoujo-tachi
description:
It was an era unknown. Long after the prosperity of the human civilization - once the ruler of the Earth - had waned, more time passed still...

Reminiscent of the edge of the world, there was a place, and in that place the tower stood tall. In the tower a scientist lived. He was alone. For humanity had abandoned this place, he desired company. Left behind by the civilization no more, it was their scientific knowledge that he had in his hands. By using their magic-like technology, he finally sets forth to create a maid robot...

title: Bunny Black
description: Bunny Black is a classic dungeon-crawl game that is composed by party management, dungeon exploration, grinding, and fulfilling missions with scaling difficulties throughout the game. Just like a lot of role-playing games that adopt the same genre, grinding is heavily emphasized in order to finish the game. In battles, players may only control the protagonist and develop him with whatever build, from both skills and equipments standpoint, possible.

title: Xtraction Royale
description: Xtraction Royale is an upcoming Battle Royale virtual reality experience developed by RevolutionVR using the award winning Unreal Engine 4, a game that will place you against other players in a fight to escape an island, winners will be rewarded with an ingame currency that can be exchanged to RVR, a cryptocurrency designed for VR and Gaming. Either alone or in squad, plan your way out by any means necessary!

title: Stand Out: VR Battle Royale
description:
Stand Out is the ultimate fight for your life. You will be parachuted on a wide island and you will have to explore your surroundings to find weapons and equipment to fight for your survival. Use vehicles to move faster and keep an eye on the deadly barrier that shrinks the battleground during the game and forces the players to murder each other. Only one will remain.

We designed the game to be the ultimate VR fighting competition. It features a wide choice of weapons fitting all fighting styles, from blades to sniper rifles. The 400 hectares wide map offers epic combat situations in forests, plains, abandoned towns, on an airport, a nuclear site and many more.

You will have to crawl through trenches to avoid enemy fire, climb up ruins to get a clear line of sight, chase your opponents in furious gunfights between motorcycles and cars on steep mountain roads. You will have to do whatever it takes to win this merciless fight.

Die, learn, and improve to finally be the last man standing.

This is Battle Royale.

title: Fallen Doll
description: In summary, Fallen Doll is a real-time next-gen hentai game with VR support.

title: Nympho Trainer
description: Hentai-inspired, light BDSM-themed VR game starring a cute, sex-addicted kitty girl trained to please her Master!

title: Viva Project
description: This is an advanced AI simulation that can interact and respond to many of your actions in a dynamic way through inverse kinematics, complex behaviors. In short, this is a tamagochi on steroids.

title: Dark Shiny
description: This Rpg I created it only for those looking for a real challenge, I'm sure that few will be able to complete my game. I myself, despite being the creator, I had difficulty. Who will have the patience and the will to succeed?

title: Dynast.io
description: 100 player 2D real-time massive multiplayer survival game in your browser! Build, Craft, Fight, Survive!

title: Tanks2.DE
description: Tanks2.DE is a 2D online multiplayer tank shooter, currently featuring 2 nations with over 30 tanks from the World War 2 era. The game is in a stable open beta state and receives continuous updates.

title: Trine: Ultimate Collection
description:
Trine: Ultimate Collection includes the first four titles in the Trine series:

- Trine Enchanted Edition
- Trine 2: Complete Story
- Trine 3: Artifacts of Power
- Trine 4: The Nightmare Prince

title: Battle Rappers Game Online
description: Take 8 mile to your desktop and freestyle against rappers around the world in real time! Make an account to unlock beats and adlibs that you can rap over to spice up your bars! Not a fan of multiplayer? Then just practice your rhyming skills with our Speech Recognition-based rhyme detector!

title: Cherry Creek
description:
Cherry Creek is a tile-turning puzzle game, set in a picturesque natural environment. The aim is to rotate the river tiles to take water from the fountain to all the cherry trees. Click the tiles to rotate them until the puzzle is complete, and lock tiles to help you finish the harder levels.

The puzzles offer something for all abilities, so enjoy a coffee break by playing a few simple levels, or set yourself a real challenge on the hardest difficulties. Try to beat your best scores, or just relax and enjoy the atmosphere.

title: American Truck Simulator: Oregon
description:
Go down the road to experience the wild beauty of "Beaver State" Oregon. The evergreen natural scenery will go along with the deserted country side but also dense city areas like Portland or Salem. Vast forests are covering roughly 60 percent of the state and together with many rivers form the typical western Oregon nature but also important part of state economics.

It is one of the most geographically diverse states in Northwest region the U.S. It is the 9th largest and, with a population of 4 million, 27th most populous state. Its natural beauty includes deep forests, plenty of water areas and rivers, but also volcanoes, high deserts, and arid scrublands.

title: American Truck Simulator: Enchanted Edition
description:
American Truck Simulator Enchanted Edition takes you on a journey through breathtaking landscapes and widely recognized landmarks of south-west United States. Deliver various cargoes across California, Nevada, Arizona and, for the first time: New Mexico, nicknamed the Land of Enchantment! 
 
Included in this special edition of the game: extended tuning options for your big rig. Make the dream of a perfect truck come true with tons of unique wheel tuning parts and custom steering wheels. 
 
Digital Content: 
 
American Truck Simulator Game 
New Mexico Map Expansion DLC 
Wheel Tuning Pack DLC  
Steering Creations Pack DLC 
Heavy Cargo Pack as a bonus 
 
Physical Content 
 
Truck Model 1:87 scale 
Double-sided Poster 480x370 mm 
Limited-series Sticker Sheet 
American Truck Simulator Lanyard 
Enchanted Edition DVD

title: Gwent: Crimson Curse
description:
Along with a multitude of new tools for waging war, Crimson Curse introduces over 100 cards across all of GWENT’s playable factions. Players will be able to afflict the enemy with Poison and Bleeding, use Shield and Vitality to defend against incoming damage, as well as attempt to turn the tide of battle using the Deathblow and Berserk gameplay mechanics.

As always, every card comes in both a standard version and a premium animated variant — one of the hallmark features of GWENT’s presentation.

title: Monster Manor
description: Deploy defense towers to defeat monsters, capture them for your automated farm, and earn growing profits. Expand your Monster Manor in the sidebar during work breaks or downtime!

title: Award Winners: Platinum Edition
description:
This compilation contains the following games:

- Frontier: Elite II
- Lemmings
- Sid Meier's Civilization

title: Ostrofa
description:
Be prepared to survive in a custom-generated, low poly environment, fighting against 
other players from all over the world

title: American Fugitive
description: Set in a sleepy American country town in the 1980s, American Fugitive invites you to play as Will Riley. You're no angel, but you're not a killer. Yet the cold-blooded murder of your dad is the crime they've locked you up for. Fuelled by grief and a burning desire for vengeance, you must break out of jail to find the real culprit. It's payback time.

title: Sak'd
description: Sak'd is an action-adventure platform game wherein players assume the role of Sak, a not-so-ordinary pillow accidentally brought to life, imbued with powerful weapon wielding, spell-casting, monster-smashing abilities and sent on a quest to destroy evil.

title: Faerie Solitaire Harvest
description: Match cards, rescue Faeries, and raise Magical Pets as you explore the many and vast enchanted worlds of Faerie Solitaire Harvest!

title: RagDollJoe
description: Toss the Rag Doll into objects and watch them fly! Can you make it to the end?

title: Boneworks
description: Boneworks is an Experimental Physics VR Adventure. Use found physics weapons, tools, and objects to fight across dangerous playscapes and mysterious architecture.

title: Daka Dara
description: Out-position your friends in this two player strategy board game. The first ever digital version of the centuries old board game, Dara.

title: Human Rights
description: Human Rights is an interactive lyric video / toy, developed as a companion piece to the song 'Human Rights' by Monster Mansion. Players explore a set of scenes and objects that relate to self expression, while listening to the song, which was inspired by the 2017 Australian same-sex marriage vote.

title: Long Sky
description: "Long Sky" is a small arcade flight avoidance game that can switch the first person perspective. It has the characteristics of fast, easy, tight, repeatable play, and has the elements of collection and challenge.

title: The Trials of Olympus III: King of the World
description: Angelo's thrilling story comes to an end in this epic conclusion to the "Trials of Olympus" trilogy. Play 100 challenging match-3 levels, use 32 upgrades to help you beat the designing Xerxes and save Greece!

title: Magnetized Knight
description: The knight is sent to a dangerous task in which he must complete all the riddles of an abandoned castle - using gravity for this.

title: MiniGolf Maker
description: Build the miniature golf course of your dreams in MiniGolf Maker. Play locally or online with up to 8 players, and Share your course with the world on the Steam Workshop.

title: Assault on Metaltron
description: Get ready to defend your metallic planet from human and orc invaders in this intense, challenging and addictive action tower defense game! Play solo or in cooperation on one pc!

title: I.Cartel
description: Bring the world to it's knees as you introduce yourself into the gruesome world of Narco-trafficking. Kill, Romance, Grow and Expand.

title: De'Vine: Card Game
description: As enchantments that bind powerful creatures to cards begin to corrode... Hell is breaking loose! Will you be clever enough to build a strong set of cards to defeat this evil? Over 300 unique CARDS to collect! Fast paced CARD BATTLE system!

title: Note: A Composer and a Note
description: "I'VE DONE SOMETHING WONDERFUL" _ PLAY Mephistowaltz NOTE : a composer and a note is an indie minimalist 2d platformer for every artist in the world. Player is both a composer and a note. This is the journey for composition with a unique mechanic. Player plays like playing the piano. It offers a thrill, fresh and meaning.

title: Heroes of Pure Land
description: "Heroes of Pure land" is an independent game that integrates strategy, cultivation and moba-like gameplay.Players need to collect all kinds of skills, and then through the battlefield, challenge the BOSS, one-on-one hit, martial arts conference and other ways to cultivate the characteristics of the hero, unify the last pure land.

title: Arvita
description: Arvita (formerly known as Astaria) is a medium fantasy MMORPG with emphasis on social gameplay, crafting, party combat, territory capture and player vs developer(PvD) style content.

title: Looking for Heals
description: Command your squad of warriors while keeping them from an early grave in this action-adventure where the healer calls the shots. Heal, shield, and resurrect your way through a world filled with impossible choices, people to save, and elaborate boss fights inspired by MMO dungeon raids.

title: 3 on 3 Super Robot Hockey
description: 3 on 3 Super Robot Hockey, how hockey should be played. No rules. Just smash, bash, and trash your opponent and score!

title: HopSquash!
description: HopSquash! is a fast & simple local couch multiplayer game, easy to get into and great for parties. Jump on your friends and rack up points! Easy for non-gamers or kids to pick up & play! Up to 8 players on the same game, multiple levels, and a level editor, with full gamepad support!

title: SpaceBullet
description: In this game , you need to control a spaceship to defeat your enemy and get your best points .There are also kinds of bullets appear in your game , if you get a tool,you can change your bullet.Just like the way to change bullets, you need to get a card tool so as to control cards to choose the fate of your spaceship.

title: Borderlight
description: Borderlight is a 2D colonist simulator with an emphasis on resources. Gather, import, and sell various resources or use them to construct buildings. Acquire settlers and assign them jobs. Level up and assign points to further increase resource incomes. Defend against zombies or lose resources trying.

title: Oik Reloaded
description:
The final part of the OIK reloaded!
You need to remove all red objects from the screen and hold the blue cube on the platform for 2 seconds!
The game simulates real physics.

title: Cold Cable: Lifeshift
description: Take role as a survivor in COLD CABLE: LIFESHIFT, a 3D First Person action-puzzle game, with survival elements, where you have to gather supplies, control radiation level and shoot monsters on your way to reach the next level. If you want to play this game, get ready for the chaos.

title: Zero One
description:
''Zero One'' is a murder mystery game

You and your partner '' CC'' has been tasked with investigating strange suicides taking place in a secluded village. People with no history of mental illness nor suicidal thoughts travel to this village and hang themselves.

Your job is to discover ''the truth''. But what will you truly find? A Sweet Lie? A Bitter Truth? Or maybe a ''Reality''?

title: Biotope: Aquarium Simulator
description: Biotope will be the most detailed and realistic aquarium simulator on the market. Biotope makes it possible to create complex aquaristic ecosystems and simulate realistic life cycles of plants and fish.

title: Stoppa!
description: Stop time and manipulate objects around you to reach the goal line!

title: Demon Club
description: Realizing the dream of being a demon king in childhood "Demon Club" is a game based on chinese mythology. It is envisioned on an overhead continent called "ShenZhou". The player is a demon with no power.

title: Destiny Hunter
description: Destiny Hunter is a story based RPG game in which you can control two characters, a female warrior and a female Archer. The story is about searching a better place to live and of course find your Destiny. You need to pass through cold places and reach into a better place to finish the game.

title: Duckumentary
description: Gather all the types of birds, and get out of here before you become fried chicken!

title: Human Sacrifice
description: When I woke up I was at a ceremonial place. Several deaths await you ahead of your choice to survive. Can you unravel this ceremony's mystery and survive?

title: Fortress of Hell
description: Can you survive inside the fortress, and free the many prisoners (including your own girlfriend!) from their unfortunate fate? Play as up to 4 different parties - you can even play evil heroes from darkness - and find out!

title: Mango Cart
description: Mango Cart is the trading game of fruits. Manage your company through the turmoil of the economical and political environment and emerge among your competitors.

title: Mutropolis
description:
A lovely SCI-FI archaeological post-apocalyptic adventure.
In the 50th century, the great humankind achievements, such as pyramids or Humphrey Bogart’s movies, were completely forgotten.
Henry and his nerdy team of archaeologists have been working hard for years, on the ground, digging treasures with the extremely rare hallmark “Made in China” and watching weird Indiana Jones documentaries.
Until some dog-looking God came to ruin everything.

title: The Color of the Roses
description: Dmitriy - successive and ambitious young man who works as a real estate agent. His seemingly quiet and regular life is dramatically changing after one unfortunate nightcall.

title: Massive Air Combat
description: Over 100 air fighters and 3D dogfight!! You can enjoy large-scaled aerial dogfight.

title: Tricky Cat
description: Help this cute cat jumping on tiles but don't fall down in this platformer.

title: Shmup Moments
description: Shmup Moments is a shoot-'em-up game that's easy to pick up and play. With arcade-like gameplay, slick controls and sound, hot beats and lighting, and a classic bullet hell ambience, it's the perfect game to chill out with when you need a break from AAA titles, or to meditate with before going to bed.

title: 100 Euro
description: The Magic Wallet once again take his quest in search for untold wealth, to fulfill the long-held dream of its owner. Go to parallel worlds to collect hundreds of euros, and make the old lady happy!

title: Cold Hearts
description: Cold Hearts is a visual novel about refrigerators, loneliness and the meaning of life. Befriend and date household appliances, melt their frozen hearts, solve the crime story and uncover the truth - the real reason why these girl-fridges made contact with you, of all people!

title: Crime Scene Cleaner
description: Once you get tangled with the mob, you will forever be a part of the mob. At least they pay a decent salary and all you have to do is clean up after their dirty work, but you know what you’re doing. So clean crime scenes, outsmart the police and get ready for the next mission.

title: Bleeding Edge VR
description: Experience the movie-like escaping plot with chasing, shooting, and thrilling! The game brings player a short but satisfying VR experience by reproducing the process of a highly-intense chasing plot with the highest quality of game graphic that you’ve ever seen so far in VR!

title: Falsemen: Rebirth
description: Humanity has become the dominant force in the world, and the devils are living under the cover of their names... Are you really willing? The world is being dominated by evil human beings!

title: Cherry Boy
description: Cherry spent all his quiet life in the foliage of Parent Tree. One not so fine day humans came and took him and his brothers away from the Great Garden. What awaits Cherry there? How to return?

title: Summerford
description: Inspired by the "golden age" of survival horror classics like the original Resident Evil, Silent Hill and Alone in the Dark, Summerford is a third person action adventure game that balances action, exploration and puzzle solving and requires careful planning to survive.

title: Michelin Rally Masters: Race of Champions
description: This is the OFFICIAL game of the real Race of Champions! Take the various authentic ROC cars (22 in all) through different tracks on head-to-head SuperSpecial challenge modes or traditional rally stages as you speed and slide through mud, gravel, snow, and more. Five levels of difficulty will let you learn at your own pace. Multiple game modes (RoC, Challenge Cup, Challenge Trophy, time attack, single race, single stage) keep you challenged. Run races online with other players through dedicated servers or setup your own.

title: Silence
description: This is my "oddly named but lovable beast of wad" (kalensar) that replaces Doom 1in the style of Doom the Way Id Did. To ensure vanilla compatibility, I've tested the wad in Chocolate Doom and cleaned up any issues I could find. This wad doesn't try to reinvent the wheel, just maybe grease up the axel a little bit. Also with the levels is a pack of midis I wrote and decided to include for use alongside the levels. That's right, the first 36 level ultimate doom megawad of 2022, and the only limit we removed was your imagination.

title: Unpacking
description: Unpacking is a job-simulator game about inspecting packages, deciding if they are accepted or denied depending on the rules of that day and doing different procedures for each package.

title: Windy Lights
description: Feel the wind... and shoot, jump, dodge, protect, speed up, make it rain, drop some bombs, throw a couple of lightning bolts and more while racing from checkpoint to checkpoint.

title: Apostatic: Revenge From Hell
description: Apostatic - Revenge From Hell is an action and adventure game set in a wild and brutal archipelago. After her own death, Hellda will return from Hell to take revenge on the invaders.

title: AI Limit
description: In the distant future when civilization is on the verge of extinction, people follow the legend of the Elysium in the last city, Havenswell. In this post-apocalyptic wasteland sci-fi ARPG, you will play as Arrisa, a Blader with immortality, and explore the city ruin to find the hope of a new life.

title: Evotinction
description: Evotinction is a third-person stealth game featuring unique hacking mechanics. The developers share an enormous passion for the stealth genre and wish to provide a complex and dynamic stealth experience for players. A variety of hacking skills, environment devices and gadgets provide rich emergent gameplay.

title: King of Texas
description: Jon Bega has just joined the Dallas Sheriffs football team in this visual novel dating sim. Play a football minigame between dates with the head cheerleader Molly and team manager Ashley.

title: F.I.S.T.: Forged In Shadow Torch
description: It is a metroidvania game that the player will play as a rabbit who can manipulate the big mech-arm on his back, exploring in a vivid diesel punk world and fighting against the evil robot army. There will be a vast world map for the player to explore to meet with friend NPCs and encounter enemies, discover items and weapons and seek for the answers for the secrets hidden behind.

title: Lost Islands
description: Explore this survival and exploration RPG game that combines adventure, escape, fantasy. All in one game!

title: Blackstar Jump Drive
description: A minimalist space travel game.

title: 7 Years From Now
description:
7 years ago, I lost my memories...
But there is one promise I can never forget--

"I'll be waiting for you, 7 years from now..."
A promise with someone I have no recollection of

To find the missing pieces of my memory
And to fulfill my promise I made that day
I came back to this town--

title: In Nightmare
description:
Closing his heart to reality, our protagonist falls into a deep slumber and awakens in a nightmarish dreamworld. In Nightmare is a narrative-driven horror adventure game combining sneak action with diverse puzzles. It follows a young boy in search for the last hope of love who is working out his own salvation by navigating through his fear.

Experiencing effects of a broken family, and the heartache it brings, a young child will escape reality into a dark, whimsical world created from his own memories. This sets him on his journey to uncover what truly lies within. Having suffered in reality, his past trauma turns into terrifying monsters that want to keep him in an eternal nightmare. With the help of his dream spirit, the boy will find ways to sneak past enemies, overcome intricate puzzles, embrace his fear, and uncover the truth so that he may be able to purify the monsters he has created, and finally wake up.

Will you overcome what you fear or be caught in the nightmare?

title: Sephirothic Stories
description: When the world tree begins to wane, what will become of the balance of the world? Discover the truth behind the world tree's waning power in a fantasy RPG! Navigate trap-filled dungeons using only your mind and wit to conquer challenging puzzles!

title: Vampire & Monsters: Hidden Object Games
description: Embark on a unique investigation in the world of ancient monsters! Solve the vampire’s castle secrets, find the way out, and put together a powerful amulet to defeat the Evil! Two Hidden Object games sharing the theme of monsters and people's interactions with them.

title: Dark Hero Party
description: Imos lives his peaceful life helping his sister Tori run a potion shop in a quiet village. However, when an order is given for all Ryuujin to hunt down the Evil King, that peace is shattered forever.

title: PacketStorm
